info.name: Committed Platform v2
info.description:
Full API test collection for the Committed LMS.

## Setup
1. Start Docker: `cd docker && docker compose up -d`
2. Import this collection into Postman.
3. Run **1 — Health** to verify connectivity.
4. Run **2.1 Register** or **2.2 Login** — tokens are captured automatically.
5. Run requests in order within each folder.

## Variables
- `gateway_url` — Gateway base URL (default: `http://localhost:8080`)
- `access_token` — Set automatically after login/register
- `refresh_token` — Set automatically after login/register
- `course_id`, `assignment_id`, `submission_id`, `grade_id`, `announcement_id`, `comment_id` — Set automatically as you create resources

## Architecture
- **Gateway** (Java Spring Boot) — :8080 — JWT auth, routing
- **Core** (PHP Symfony) — :8000 — data persistence
- **Code Analyzer** (Python Flask) — :5000 — AI code analysis
- **Notifications** (.NET) — :5001 — email delivery
- **Redis** — :6379 — JWT blacklist and token versioning
